name: 07751 · Morganville, NJ
findings: ZIP 07751 (Morganville) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07751 (Morganville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07751 (Morganville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 30% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
